subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Speech without prior preparation
solution:
The correct answer is: **Extempore**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Extempore"** means a speech or performance done without any preparation. (बिना पूर्व तैयारी के भाषण या प्रदर्शन)
 
• **​"Extempore" **is used to describe something that is spoken or done without preparation.
 
 
• Example: She gave an impressive **extempore **speech at the event.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Debate **(वाद-विवाद): A formal discussion on a particular topic.

 
 
• **Example:** The students participated in a lively **debate **about environmental issues.
 
 
 
• **Lecture **(व्याख्यान): An educational talk to an audience.
 
 
• **Example: **The professor gave a **lecture **on quantum physics.
 
 
 
• **Rambling** (बेतरतीब): Talking or writing in a confused or inconsequential way.
 
 
• **Example:** His **rambling **speech confused the audience.
